usage: agentware plan set-status [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                 feature number {todo,wip,done}

positional arguments:
  feature               feature slug; dir under work/
  number                task number to flip
  {todo,wip,done}       new status

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
